title: Ransom note
description: Ransomware note as found on an encrypted machine: a full-screen lock screen or a README text file open in a plain text editor. Fictional group names, wallets and addresses only.

text.description: Body of the note. Newlines kept. Threatening but no real instructions beyond the fictional contact details.
examples: All files on this network have been encrypted with military grade algorithms. Backups were deleted.

timer.description: Countdown shown on the lock screen, HH:MM:SS.

deadline.description: When the price doubles / data is published.

victimId.description: Victim/machine key the attackers ask for.

fileName.description: Notepad variant: name of the note file.

examples: We have copied 214 GB including badge records and the security program.
